sections.Profile:
The "Crossword" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in April 1959, was designed by the renowned Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin. This electro-mechanical machine features two flippers and nine gobble holes, allowing players to complete a crossword puzzle by hitting the correct targets.
